item.title: MicroKits Banan-a Synth | NAMM 2026 | KUCR
item.description: video upload by KUCR "MicroKits gives us a sneak peak of their upcoming release, Banana-a Synth! A fun instrument for all ages. 'Turn everyday conductive objects into musical notes with the included alligator clips. Just clip things to the touchpad and create a path to ground. Experiment with conductivity and learn what it means to complete a circuit.'"
